Ingredients

Serves 2

  • 200 g spaghetti
  • 1 unwaxed lemon
  • 40 g Parmesan, finely grated
  • 2 tbsp unsalted butter
  • 1 small garlic clove, finely grated
  • 1 handful fresh basil
  • Salt and freshly cracked black pepper

Method

  1. Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti until just shy of al dente.
  2. Meanwhile, zest the lemon into a large heatproof bowl. Add the Parmesan, butter, garlic, and a generous grind of pepper.
  3. Reserve 250 ml of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti. Add it to the bowl with 100 ml of pasta water.
  4. Toss vigorously until the butter and cheese melt into a glossy sauce. Add more pasta water as needed.
  5. Finish with lemon juice to taste, torn basil, and extra Parmesan.
Inspired by Bon Appétit ↗

Ingredients

Serves 4

  • 2 × 400 g cans chickpeas, drained and dried
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 250 g cooked brown rice
  • 1 cucumber, sliced
  • 200 g cherry tomatoes, halved
  • 3 tbsp tahini
  • 1 lemon, juiced
  • Salt and freshly cracked black pepper

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chickpeas with cumin, paprika, olive oil, and salt.
  2. Roast on a large tray for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and golden.
  3. Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, 3 tablespoons of cold water, and a pinch of salt.
  4. Divide the rice, cucumber, and tomatoes between bowls. Add the hot chickpeas and spoon over the dressing.
Inspired by BBC Good Food ↗

Ingredients

Serves 2

  • 100 g rolled oats
  • 1 tbsp chia seeds
  • 1 tsp ground cinnamon
  • 250 ml milk or oat milk
  • 100 g Greek-style yogurt
  • 1 tbsp maple syrup
  • 1 apple, thinly sliced
  • 2 tbsp toasted almonds

Method

  1. Stir the oats, chia seeds, and cinnamon together in a lidded container.
  2. Add the milk, yogurt, and maple syrup. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
  3. Loosen with a splash of milk in the morning, then divide between two bowls.
  4. Top with sliced apple, toasted almonds, and an extra pinch of cinnamon.
Inspired by Cookie and Kate ↗
